name: Place Cell Coding
description: Spatial representation via hippocampal place cells used metaphorically for conceptual spaces. Extension from O'Keefe's place cells (physical locations) to abstract semantic or conceptual spaces. Speculative; neural evidence in conceptual domains limited.
key_references: O'Keefe, J. (1976). Place units in the hippocampus of the freely moving rat. Experimental Neurology, 51(1), 78-109.
Damasio, A. R. (1989). The Brain Binds Entities and Events by Multiregional Activation from Convergence Zones. Neural Computation, 1(1), 123-132.
empirical_evidence: Solid evidence for place cells in physical space (Nobel Prize 2014). Speculative extension: some hippocampal cells show selectivity for conceptual features. Mathematical analogy to conceptual spaces (Gärdenfors). No direct evidence that place coding extends to semantics; could be coincidental selectivity.

parameters.coding_geometry: Euclidean for space; undefined for concepts
